proposals.evidence: DEDR 410 Toda: i- (same meaning as Ko.); i Q ( obl. in-) this person or thing; pl. i Q a·m; adj. i; i Q ïd because of this; i Q i· like this; iṯ in this direction; iṯïk a little in this direction; il in this place, here; iṯs̱n, is̱n from this… The survey il “here” corresponds to this Toda form and sense.
